where: The muted text tone: ledes, metadata lines, card details, the footer and the miniature frames, on the canvas, on cards and on code blocks

measured.light: 6.1:1 on the canvas, 6.4:1 on a card
measured.dark: 7.9:1 on the canvas, 7.0:1 on a card, 5.7:1 on a raised frame

reason: The site's colours are the app's tokens of the pinned release, never retuned here; the release that moves the muted tone to 7:1 brings it to this site with the next bundle pin.
route: Your system's increase-contrast setting, once the pinned release carries the high-contrast tokens; until then the default text tone is used for every sentence that matters.
endsWhen: the pinned bundle's muted tone measures 7:1 on the canvas and on cards in light

where: The white label of the primary buttons on the emerald accent, and on its hover colour

measured.light: 5.5:1 on the accent, 7.7:1 on its hover colour

reason: 7:1 would need an accent a quarter darker than the brand's emerald, which is the colour that makes OpenTodo recognisable, on the site as in the app.
route: Your system's increase-contrast setting, once the pinned release carries the high-contrast tokens, draws the buttons black on white or white on black.

where: Links and kickers drawn in the accent colour on the canvas and on cards, and the current navigation item on its tint

measured.light: 5.2:1 on the canvas and on the tint

reason: Accent text is the accent itself; a 7:1 version would be a different, darker colour next to the buttons.
route: Your system's increase-contrast setting, once the pinned release carries the high-contrast tokens, draws links in the text colour with an underline.

where: An overdue date in the danger colour inside the home page's filter and quick-add miniatures

measured.light: 4.6:1 on the canvas, 4.8:1 on a card
measured.dark: 7.3:1 on the canvas, 6.5:1 on a card

reason: The danger colour carries its meaning by hue, as in the app; at 7:1 it would read as plain text.
route: The miniatures demonstrate the filter language and quick add; nothing in them is content to act on. Your system's increase-contrast setting takes the hue to 7:1 once the pinned release carries the high-contrast tokens.

where: The preview banner shown only on a build from an unreleased app, never on the live site
reason: The banner uses the app's warning tint and text as the pinned release defines them; the production build refuses a preview, so no visitor meets it.
route: Not on the live site; the release that retunes the warning text brings it to 7:1 with the next bundle pin.
endsWhen: the pinned bundle's warning text measures 7:1 on its tint in light

where: The white label of the Discord button on Discord's own blurple (#5865F2), in the footer and on the pages that invite you to the server
reason: Discord's brand colour is what makes the button recognisable as Discord's; the community spec asks for it (website-community "Discord button").
route: The same invitation is a plain text link in the footer's Project list, in the page's text colour at 7:1 or better.
